details:
We’re looking for a talented
Full-Stack Developer
to join a high-impact team delivering scalable, cloud-based digital solutions in the education space. You’ll work across the full stack—designing, building, and maintaining enterprise-grade applications that make a real difference.
What you’ll do
Own the full software development lifecycle—from design to deployment.
Build and enhance complex systems using Java, Node.js, AWS, and modern frameworks.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams in an Agile/DevOps environment.
Ensure high standards in testing, performance, and security.
Support and troubleshoot production systems and integrations.
What you bring
5–10 years of experience in enterprise software development.
Strong skills in Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Node.js, AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
Experience with containerisation (OpenShift, Docker), CI/CD, and monitoring tools.
Solid understanding of microservices, APIs, and event-driven architecture.
Familiarity with tools like Git, Bamboo, Nexus, Splunk, Kafka, ElasticSearch.
Passion for clean code, continuous learning, and solving complex problems.
Ready to build meaningful tech that supports education?
Apply now and be part of something impactful.
